description: This Java class 'ImmutableObsInterceptor' is part of the OpenMRS project, specifically within the Hibernate database interceptors for the OpenMRS API. It extends a base interceptor to enforce immutability on 'Obs' entities, preventing modifications once they are created, with specific behaviors for voided observations.

classes.name: ImmutableObsInterceptor
classes.description: A Hibernate interceptor for the Obs entity that enforces immutability constraints on observation records within OpenMRS, with configurable handling for voided and mutable properties.

methods.name: getSupportedType
methods.description: Returns the class type this interceptor supports, which is Obs.

methods.name: getMutablePropertyNames
methods.description: Provides the list of property names that are allowed to be modified in the entity.

methods.name: ignoreVoidedOrRetiredObjects
methods.description: Determines whether the interceptor should ignore entities that have been voided or retired.
